verses.en: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.pt: Farás também o altar de madeira de acácia; de cinco côvados será o comprimento, de cinco côvados a largura (será quadrado o altar), e de três côvados a altura.
verses.en_web: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square: and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And make an altar of hard wood, a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.pt: E farás as suas pontas nos seus quatro cantos; as suas pontas formarão uma só peça com o altar; e o cobrirás de bronze.
verses.en_web: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it; and you shall overlay it with brass.
verses.en_bbe: Put horns at the four angles of it, made of the same, plating it all with brass.

verses.en: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.pt: Far-lhe-ás também os cinzeiros, para recolher a sua cinza, e as pás, e as bacias, e os garfos e os braseiros; todos os seus utensílios farás de bronze.
verses.en_web: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes, its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans: all its vessels you shall make of brass.
verses.en_bbe: And make all its vessels, the baskets for taking away the dust of the fire, the spades and basins and meat-hooks and fire-trays, of brass.

verses.en: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.pt: Far-lhe-ás também um crivo de bronze em forma de rede, e farás para esta rede quatro argolas de bronze nos seus quatro cantos,
verses.en_web: You shall make a grating for it of network of brass: and on the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
verses.en_bbe: And make a network of brass, with four brass rings at its four angles.

verses.en: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.pt: e a porás em baixo da borda em volta do altar, de maneira que a rede chegue até o meio do altar.
verses.en_web: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And put the network under the shelf round the altar so that the net comes half-way up the altar.

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.pt: Farás também varais para o altar, varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobrirás de bronze.
verses.en_web: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.en_bbe: And make rods for the altar, of hard wood, plated with brass.

verses.en: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.pt: Os varais serão metidos nas argolas, e estarão de um e de outro lado do altar, quando for levado.
verses.en_web: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar, when carrying it.
verses.en_bbe: And put the rods through the rings at the two opposite sides of the altar, for lifting it.

verses.en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.pt: èco, de tábuas, o farás; como se te mostrou no monte, assim o farão.
verses.en_web: You shall make it with hollow planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: The altar is to be hollow, boarded in with wood; make it from the design which you saw on the mountain.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.pt: Farás também o átrio do tabernáculo. No lado que dá para o sul o átrio terá cortinas de linho fino torcido, de cem côvados de comprimento.
verses.en_web: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.en_bbe: And let there be an open space round the House, with hangings for its south side of the best linen, a hundred cubits long.

verses.en: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.pt: As suas colunas serão vinte, e vinte as suas bases, todas de bronze; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas serão de prata.
verses.en_web: and its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.en_bbe: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases are to be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their bands are to be of silver.

verses.en: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.pt: Assim também ao longo do lado do norte haverá cortinas de cem côvados de comprimento, e serão vinte as suas colunas e vinte as bases destas, todas de bronze; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas serão de prata.
verses.en_web: Likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.en_bbe: And on the north side in the same way, hangings a hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars of brass on bases of brass; their hooks and their bands are to be of silver.

verses.en: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.pt: E na largura do átrio do lado do ocidente haverá cortinas de cinqüenta côvados; serão dez as suas colunas, e dez as bases destas.
verses.en_web: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.en_bbe: And for the open space on the west side, the hangings are to be fifty cubits wide, with ten pillars and ten bases;

verses.en: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente a largura do átrio do lado que dá para o nascente será de cinqüenta côvados.
verses.en_web: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And on the east side the space is to be fifty cubits wide.

verses.en: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.pt: As cortinas para um lado da porta serão de quinze côvados; três serão as suas colunas, e três as bases destas.
verses.en_web: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.en_bbe: On the one side of the doorway will be hangings fifteen cubits long, with three pillars and three bases;

verses.en: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.pt: E de quinze côvados serão as cortinas para o outro lado; as suas colunas serão três, e três as bases destas.
verses.en_web: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.en_bbe: And on the other side, hangings fifteen cubits long, with three pillars and three bases.

verses.en: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.pt: Também à porta do átrio haverá um reposteiro de vinte côvados, de azul, púrpura, carmesim, e linho fino torcido, obra de bordador; as suas colunas serão quatro, e quatro as bases destas.
verses.en_web: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.en_bbe: And across the doorway, a veil of twenty cubits of the best linen, made of needlework of blue and purple and red, with four pillars and four bases.

verses.en: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.pt: Todas as colunas do átrio ao redor serão cingidas de faixas de prata; os seus colchetes serão de prata, porém as suas bases de bronze.
verses.en_web: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.en_bbe: All the pillars round the open space are to have silver bands, with hooks of silver and bases of brass.

verses.en: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.pt: O comprimento do átrio será de cem côvados, e a largura, por toda a extensão, de cinqüenta, e a altura de cinco côvados; as cortinas serão de linho fino torcido; e as bases das colunas de bronze.
verses.en_web: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.en_bbe: The open space is to be a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, with sides five cubits high, curtained with the best linen, with bases of brass.

verses.en: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.pt: Todos os utensílios do tabernáculo em todo o seu serviço, e todas as suas estacas, e todas as estacas do átrio, serão de bronze.
verses.en_web: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.en_bbe: All the instruments for the work of the House, and all its nails, and the nails of the open space are to be of brass.

verses.en: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.pt: Ordenarás aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de oliveiras, batido, para o candeeiro, para manter uma lâmpada acesa continuamente.
verses.en_web: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clear olive oil for the lights, so that a light may be burning there at all times.

verses.en: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Na tenda da revelação, fora do véu que está diante do testemunho, Arão e seus filhos a conservarão em ordem, desde a tarde até pela manhã, perante o Senhor; este será um estatuto perpétuo para os filhos de Israel pelas suas gerações.
verses.en_web: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Let Aaron and his sons put this in order, evening and morning, before the Lord, inside the Tent of meeting, outside the veil which is before the ark; this is to be an order for ever, from generation to generation, to be kept by the children of Israel.
